Subject: Mathematics
Chapters: GST; Banking (recurring deposit); Shares and Dividends
How to write the answer: Write the formula, then substitute with ₹ and % units, and state the final answer in a sentence.
How to prepare fast: Short and scoring: practise ten questions of each type from the specimen and past papers.

Subject: Mathematics
Chapters: Linear inequations; Quadratic equations; Ratio and proportion; Factorisation; Matrices; Progressions
How to write the answer: Show every step; for word problems, define the variable first and check the answer fits the question.
How to prepare fast: The largest part of the syllabus: do quadratic word problems and matrices daily.

Subject: Mathematics
Chapters: Similarity; Loci; Circles; Constructions; Coordinate geometry (reflection, section formula, equation of a line)
How to write the answer: Give a reason for every statement in proofs; draw constructions with a sharp pencil and keep the arcs.
How to prepare fast: Circle theorems and constructions come up in Section B almost every year.

Subject: Mathematics
Chapters: Cylinder, cone and sphere; combinations of solids
How to write the answer: Write the formula, keep the units, and say clearly what is being found.
How to prepare fast: Make one formula sheet and practise conversion (melting and recasting) problems.

Subject: Mathematics
Chapters: Identities; Heights and distances
How to write the answer: Draw the figure and mark angles; for identities, work on one side only.
How to prepare fast: Practise ten identities and ten heights-and-distances problems with the tables.

Subject: Mathematics
Chapters: Mean, median, quartiles and mode; histograms and ogives
How to write the answer: Draw graphs to scale on graph paper and label both axes.
How to prepare fast: Graph questions are quick marks if the scale is right.

Subject: Mathematics
Chapters: Probability
How to write the answer: List the sample space first.
How to prepare fast: Easy marks: dice, coins and cards.

Subject: Physics (Science Paper 1)
Chapters: Force; Work, Energy and Power; Machines
How to write the answer: Numericals: formula, values with SI units, answer with unit. Draw lever and pulley diagrams.
How to prepare fast: Machines (MA, VR, efficiency) and moment of force numericals are asked every year.

Subject: Physics (Science Paper 1)
Chapters: Refraction at plane surfaces; Refraction through a lens; Spectrum
How to write the answer: Ray diagrams with a ruler and arrows; give the sign convention you use.
How to prepare fast: Practise lens ray diagrams, critical angle and total internal reflection.

Subject: Physics (Science Paper 1)
Chapters: Sound
How to write the answer: Define terms exactly (natural, forced vibrations, resonance) and give one example each.
How to prepare fast: Echo numericals and the characteristics of sound.

Subject: Physics (Science Paper 1)
Chapters: Current electricity; Household circuits; Electromagnetism
How to write the answer: Draw circuit diagrams with standard symbols; show the series/parallel calculation.
How to prepare fast: Resistor combinations, power and energy bills, and the AC generator and motor.

Subject: Physics (Science Paper 1)
Chapters: Calorimetry
How to write the answer: State the principle of calorimetry and write heat lost = heat gained before substituting.
How to prepare fast: Specific and latent heat numericals.

Subject: Physics (Science Paper 1)
Chapters: Radioactivity
How to write the answer: Write nuclear equations with mass and atomic numbers balanced.
How to prepare fast: Alpha, beta and gamma changes and their properties.

Subject: Chemistry (Science Paper 2)
Chapters: Periodic properties and their variations; Chemical bonding
How to write the answer: Explain trends with a reason (atomic size, ionisation potential). Draw electron-dot structures.
How to prepare fast: Learn the trends down a group and across a period as a table.

Subject: Chemistry (Science Paper 2)
Unit: Acids, Bases and Salts; Analytical Chemistry
Chapters: Acids, bases and salts; Analytical chemistry (reactions with ammonium and sodium hydroxide)
How to write the answer: Write balanced equations and give the observation (colour of precipitate).
How to prepare fast: Make a table of precipitate colours; it answers many short questions.

Subject: Chemistry (Science Paper 2)
Chapters: Mole concept; Gay-Lussac's law; empirical and molecular formula
How to write the answer: Show the calculation steps and units; state the law used.
How to prepare fast: Practise ten numericals; they are high-scoring with method.

Subject: Chemistry (Science Paper 2)
Chapters: Electrolysis; Metallurgy (aluminium); alloys
How to write the answer: Write electrode reactions for each electrode and name the products.
How to prepare fast: Electrolysis of copper sulphate and the extraction of aluminium are asked often.

Subject: Chemistry (Science Paper 2)
Chapters: Hydrogen chloride; Ammonia; Nitric acid; Sulphuric acid
How to write the answer: Laboratory preparation: reactants, equation, conditions and a labelled diagram.
How to prepare fast: Learn the four lab preparations and their key reactions.

Subject: Chemistry (Science Paper 2)
Chapters: Organic chemistry
How to write the answer: IUPAC names, structures and reactions with conditions.
How to prepare fast: Homologous series, isomers and the reactions of alkanes, alkenes, alkynes, alcohols and acids.

Subject: Biology (Science Paper 3)
Chapters: Cell cycle and cell division; Genetics
How to write the answer: Draw and label the stages of mitosis; use Punnett squares for crosses.
How to prepare fast: Genetics crosses and mitosis versus meiosis tables.

Subject: Biology (Science Paper 3)
Chapters: Absorption by roots; Transpiration; Photosynthesis; Chemical coordination in plants
How to write the answer: Give experiments with aim, set-up, observation and conclusion.
How to prepare fast: Learn the standard experiments and their diagrams.

Subject: Biology (Science Paper 3)
Chapters: Circulatory, excretory, nervous, endocrine and reproductive systems
How to write the answer: Labelled diagrams (heart, nephron, eye, ear, brain); use correct terms.
How to prepare fast: Diagram practice daily: these chapters carry most long answers.

Subject: Biology (Science Paper 3)
Chapters: Population; Pollution
How to write the answer: Answer with causes, effects and measures in points.
How to prepare fast: Short chapters; revise with a one-page summary.

Subject: English, History & Civics, Geography
Chapters: Composition, letter, notice and comprehension; prescribed texts
How to write the answer: Plan compositions before writing; follow the letter format exactly; quote from the text in literature answers.
How to prepare fast: Write one composition and one letter every week and get them checked.

Subject: English, History & Civics, Geography
Chapters: Union Parliament, Executive and Judiciary; Indian National Movement; contemporary world
How to write the answer: Answer in points with dates and names; state constitutional provisions precisely.
How to prepare fast: Make timelines for the national movement and tables for Parliament's powers.

Subject: English, History & Civics, Geography
Chapters: Topographical map interpretation; map of India; physical and economic geography of India
How to write the answer: Read the toposheet carefully and use grid references; on the India map, mark and label clearly.
How to prepare fast: Practise one toposheet and one India map a week.
